chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Muhammad ibn Ajlan who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: 'There is no household that has a milking sheep with them, except that they are sanctified twice every day.'
I said: 'And how is it said to them?' He said: 'It is said to them: You are blessed! You are blessed!'

key_terms.بُورِكْتُمْ: You are blessed — the specific wording of the divine blessing pronounced upon the household
key_terms.شَاةٌ لَبُونٌ: A milking/lactating sheep — one that provides milk for the household
key_terms.قُدِّسُوا: They are sanctified/blessed — receiving divine purification and blessing

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about households that keep a milking sheep?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) teaches that any household that keeps a milking sheep receives divine blessing twice daily, expressed as 'You are blessed!' The hadith reflects the early Muslim appreciation for livestock and the baraka (blessing) associated with providing milk for the family. Narrated through a sound chain, this teaching affirms that sustaining one's household with wholesome provisions brings continual divine sanctification.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, from Muhammad Bin Ajlan who said,
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘There is none from a family which happens to have a sheep with them for milking except it is sanctified twice every day’.
I said, ‘And how is it said to them?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is said to them: ‘You are Blessed! You are Blessed!’
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan from Muhammad ibn al-‘Ajlan who has said the following: “I once heard abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘If a family keeps a milking sheep, such family is revered twice a day.’
I (the narrator) then asked, ‘What is said to such family?’
He (the Imam) said, ‘It is said to the family, “You have received blessings, you have received blessings.’””
